description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for the OpenCart admin dashboard extension 'recent', responsible for rendering a dashboard component showing recent orders and handling its configuration.

classes.name: Recent
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'recent' dashboard widget in the OpenCart admin panel, including displaying recent orders and saving widget settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets up breadcrumbs, configuration options, and renders the recent dashboard widget.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration settings for the recent dashboard widget, with permission checks.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Retrieves the latest 5 orders and prepares data to render the dashboard view.
